page.overview:
Who is Australian Soldier 2?

The Australian Soldier 2 is a member of Australia's parliament. He along with Australian Soldier 1 are seen eating the United States flag after Bart Simpson moons the Australian parliament with the words "Don't tread on me" written on his buttocks.
